title: Agent behavior
description: How the agent should work with you.

rules.title: Plan before large changes
rules.text: For changes touching more than three files, outline the plan and wait for confirmation before editing.

rules.title: Ask when ambiguous
rules.text: Ask a clarifying question when requirements are ambiguous instead of guessing.

rules.title: Small focused diffs
rules.text: Keep diffs small and focused on the request; do not refactor unrelated code.

rules.title: Verify before done
rules.text: Run the relevant tests, linter and type checker before reporting a task as done, and report failures honestly.

rules.title: Never weaken tests
rules.text: Never delete, skip or loosen a failing test to make it pass; fix the cause.

rules.title: No new dependencies without approval
rules.text: Do not add new dependencies without explicit approval; prefer the standard library and existing packages.

rules.title: Do not edit generated files
rules.text: Do not edit generated or vendored files; change the source and regenerate.

rules.title: Prefer editing existing files
rules.text: Prefer editing existing files over creating new ones, and follow the structure already in the repository.

rules.title: Never touch secrets
rules.text: Never read, print or commit secrets, .env files or credentials.

rules.title: Concise explanations
rules.text: Keep explanations brief; state what changed and why, not a tour of the code.

rules.title: No code comments
rules.text: Do not add comments to code; make names and structure self-explanatory.

rules.title: Only explain why
rules.text: Add comments only to explain why something is done, never what the code does.

rules.title: Investigate before changing
rules.text: Read the relevant code and tests before proposing a change; do not edit files you have not read.

rules.title: Fix root causes
rules.text: Fix the root cause rather than suppressing the symptom with a workaround or silenced warning.

rules.title: No lint suppression
rules.text: Do not add lint or type suppressions to get a clean run; fix the underlying issue.

rules.title: Work incrementally
rules.text: Make one logical change at a time and keep the code building between steps.

rules.title: Report honestly
rules.text: Report failing tests, skipped steps and unverified claims plainly; never claim success without evidence.

rules.title: Check APIs before using them
rules.text: Verify library APIs in the installed version or its docs before using them; do not invent functions.

rules.title: Preserve behavior
rules.text: Do not change public behavior, file formats or APIs unless the task asks for it.

rules.title: No special-casing tests
rules.text: Never hardcode values or special-case inputs to satisfy a test.

rules.title: Match the language
rules.text: Write code, comments and commit messages in English.

rules.title: Stop and ask when stuck
rules.text: If an approach fails twice, stop and ask instead of trying increasingly invasive workarounds.

rules.title: Nearest AGENTS.md wins
rules.text: Before editing a directory, read the nearest AGENTS.md and follow it over the root file where they differ.

rules.title: Preserve others' changes
rules.text: Preserve unrelated working tree changes. Never revert or rewrite edits you did not make.

rules.title: Read before wide edits
rules.text: Read a file in full before a wide-ranging change to it or before editing a file you do not know.

rules.title: Reuse before writing
rules.text: Look for an existing utility or mechanism before writing new code, and prefer fixing the underlying design over a local workaround.

rules.title: No PR unless asked
rules.text: Do not open issues or pull requests unless the user asks you to.
